title: Import Classical Musnad & Sunan Collections (non-Kutub al-Sittah)
description: Extract 4 classical collections (Ahmad, Darimi, Shafi'i, Muwatta — ~30k hadiths) from pure_canon.jsonl into a clean CSV, map sanad to existing narrator IDs, merge translations, then import via existing pipeline. Anthologies (Albani, Talidi, Ghumari) deferred to a separate scholarly analysis track.
